description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to clinical excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in shaping the quality of care provided, fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. We are looking to fill this position quickly with a qualified candidate who is ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team.
